title: Transaction Services Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking a highly motivated Manager to join our Transaction Services team in India, specializing in financial due diligence. The role offers the unique opportunity to build and lead an offshore team and collaborate with US-based transaction services team. You will also have the opportunity to work on a high volume of deals with a particular focus on healthcare services. You will be a key contributor in analyzing financial performance, preparing meeting agendas, client deliverables, and providing insights that drive informed decision-making.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements.
* Perform detailed analysis of financial statements, quality of earnings, working capital, and cash flow.
* Develop and manage complex financial analyses using advanced Excel skills (PowerQuery, PowerPivot, and other data tools).
* Prepare management meeting agendas and coordinate follow-ups.
* Review and synthesize information from data room materials to identify key issues and risks.
* Prepare client-ready databooks and reports summarizing key findings.
* Collaborate with US-based teams to deliver timely, high-quality work products.
* Contribute to project management, including coordinating with clients and managing deliverables.

**Qualifications:**
Undergraduate degree required (Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics or related field preferred).
  
  

* 3+ years of relevant experience in Transaction Services, Financial Due Diligence, or related deal advisory services at a professional services firm.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel (PowerQuery, PowerPivot, data modeling, and visualization).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and ability to work in a team-oriented, deadline-driven environment.
* Healthcare transaction services experience is a plus, though not required.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Executive - Financial Reporting
description:
**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global AdTech company providing programmatic and digital advertising solutions to brands, agencies, and app developers across international markets. Headquartered in India with an expanding footprint across Southeast Asia, MENA, Europe, the UK, and the Americas, Xapads operates with a diverse workforce of 200+ employees worldwide. Built on a culture of trust, transparency, and innovation, Xapads has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four consecutive years and is ranked among India's Top 100 Companies for Women.

**For more information, visit**

https://www.xapads.com

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Accounts & Finance function at Xapads operates as an integrated team managing accounting, taxation, financial reporting, payroll, and financial controls across domestic and international operations. The Financial Reporting segment is responsible for turning accurate financial records into structured financial statements, period-end closures, management analysis, and statutory compliance documentation to ensure financial integrity, control, and visibility.

**THE ROLE**

The Executive - Financial Reporting will assist in the preparation of period-end and year-end financial statements, supporting schedules, and account reconciliations. This role ensures timely books closure, accurate financial disclosures, and reliable data analysis for management reporting and statutory audit support.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Preparation and accuracy of year-end financial statements, financial schedules, reconciliations, and supporting working papers.
* Execution of tasks supporting month-end and year-end books closure and the finalization of accounts.
* Maintenance and updating of financial dashboards, analysis reports, and management documentation.
* Statutory and external audit support through complete, accurate audit schedules and financial documentation.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Assist in preparing period-end and year-end financial statements along with related supporting schedules and reconciliations.
* Support month-end and year-end books closure and the finalization of accounts.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, variance drivers, discrepancies, and unusual account movements.
* Maintain and regularly update financial dashboards, management reporting schedules, and financial analysis files.
* Apply fundamental accounting principles and IFRS guidelines to financial reporting activities and working papers.
* Assist statutory auditors and external consultants by providing financial statements, schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents.
* Identify continuous improvement opportunities within financial reporting processes to enhance reporting accuracy and controls.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B. Com), Master’s degree (M. Com), MBA in Finance, or CA Inter / CA IPCC qualification.
* **Experience:**
  3 – 4 years of hands-on experience in financial reporting and accounting.
* **Core Skills:**
  Experience in month-end and year-end books closure and financial statement compilation.
* **Reconciliation & Analysis:**
  Strong analytical capability with a track record of owning financial reconciliations and balance sheet schedules.
* **Tools & Software:**
  Working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, Pivot Tables, and financial data analysis.
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Proficiency in understanding of core financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and accounting principles.
* **Execution & Accuracy:**
  Good attention to detail, accuracy, and the ability to meet strict period-end reporting deadlines.
* **Communication:**
  Good verbal and written communication skills to coordinate effectively with internal finance teams and external auditors.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Basic understanding or working knowledge of IFRS.
* Direct experience interacting with statutory auditors, consultants, or external accounting advisors.
* Hands-on experience developing or maintaining financial dashboards and MIS reports.
* Prior experience with international financial reporting will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of statutory filings in the US, UK, Dubai or Singapore will be viewed favourably.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Timely and accurate preparation of period-end and year-end financial statements, closure schedules, and ledger reconciliations.
* Seamless coordination with statutory auditors resulting in smooth audit cycles with complete documentation.
* Consistent delivery of reliable financial analysis and updated management dashboards to support finance leadership.

**LIFE AT XAPADS MEDIA**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

**LOCATION**

Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**HOW TO APPLY**

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (careers@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
**THE ROLE**
Reporting to the Head of FP&A for International, this position in the FP&A team will play a critical role as the company goes through an exciting period of transformation.
  
  
The Finance Business Partner will work alongside different departments, providing financial information and analysis to senior management, helping them make more informed decisions and
**driving business strategy.**
A Finance Business Partner is a financial professional who collaborates closely with various departments or business units within an organization. They bridge the gap between finance and operations, providing financial insights, analysis, and strategic guidance to support decision-making.
  
  
This role involves helping business units meet their financial goals, optimizing resources, and aligning financial strategies with overall organizational objectives.
  
  
The role is suitable for a candidate with 2 plus years post qualifying experience as a finance business partner, with exposure to supporting a sales team. Prior industry experience is not required to be considered for the role.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Act as the key finance business partner for the APAC region, communicating effectively with all key stakeholders, within and external to finance, to provide insight, analytics and support to improve the performance of the business – including creation of own insight, additional to supporting inbound requests.
* Production of monthly revenue reporting, working with the sales team to ensure accurate and consistent reporting.
* Ownership of budgeting and forecasting processes for the whole P&L, including detailed modelling, analytics and presentation packs to senior members of the regional and global team.
* Production of monthly P&L packs, to provide insight on business performance, including presentation of monthly figures back to regional MDs.
* Presenting financial performance, full-year forecasts and budget variances, including understanding financial opportunities and risk
* Work closely with the sales team, to ensure data is accurate, and provide analysis to support decision making.
* Support the implementation of new systems, such as our new CRM, working to validate the integrity of the new system, and ensuring other linked systems produce accurate and insightful information.
* Challenging current ways of working.
* Driving efficiencies and cost savings wherever possible by identifying financial risks and working with business units to develop mitigation strategies.
* Understanding the cost drivers of the business and providing insight to non-finance members. Provide financial input into strategic plans, helping identify opportunities for growth and cost optimization.
* Ensure compliance with financial regulations and reporting standards.
* Support internal and external audits and address financial compliance issues.

**Skills And Attributes**

* Being recognized as an expert financial advisor who is open and approachable in their demeanor and adapts their communication according to the stakeholder and is able to communicate complex financial information to all levels.
* Positive in their outlook – focuses on identifying solutions to problems.
* Interpersonal skills and ability to motivate and develop staff.
* Thrives on the challenge of adapting quickly to a fast-paced environment in processes and/or systems and is comfortable working with information from multiple and sometimes complex sources.
* Working off own initiative, in a fast paced environment, and being proactive to foresee what needs to be done vs it being prescribed fully.
* Excellent attention to detail including strong organizational skills.
* Analytical skills - Proficiency in data analysis and financial modelling to dissect complex financial information and extract actionable insights.
* Communication - Exceptional communication skills are vital for conveying financial information clearly to non-financial stakeholders, fostering collaboration, and building relationships.
* Strategic thinking - The ability to align financial strategies with organizational goals and contribute to long-term planning is essential.
* Problem solving – You must be adept at identifying financial challenges, proposing solutions, and adapting to changing circumstances.
* Teamwork - Collaborating with cross-functional teams and fostering a sense of partnership is important for successful financial integration.
* Adaptability - The financial landscape evolves, so Finance Business Partners must stay flexible and open to change.

**Educations And Experience**

* Experience as a finance business partner, with multiple examples of working with finance and non-finance stakeholders, and being able to influence and support them and their decisions in a positive manner.
* Specific experience as a finance business partner supporting a sales team, with multiple examples of challenge, support, and influence leading to increased revenue and improved margin.
* Strong financial modelling and advanced Excel knowledge, must be proficient and able to work independently with Pivot Tables, VLookups and SUMIFS.
* Experience with using BI dashboards as the source of data and insights, and a strong ability to create and adapt reports within Power BI specifically.
* Highly IT literate, comfortable operating and learning new systems
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Relevant work experience in finance, accounting, or business analysis is crucial, often gained through working in Financial Analyst or Accountant positions.
* Experience implementing and maintaining financial controls.
* Experience of revenue and P&L reporting.
* Experience of being heavily involved in the budgeting process.
* A finance qualification is required (CIMA/ACCA /ACA qualified).
* Experience with Microsoft D365 and IBM is an added advantage.

Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking a
**Forensic Accounting Senior Consultant**
to support complex investigations, litigation matters, fraud risk assessments, regulatory inquiries, and financial analysis engagements. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting knowledge, analytical skills, commercial awareness, and clear communication to help clients identify risks, understand financial impact, and make informed business decisions.
  
  
You will work with clients and engagement teams to investigate financial irregularities, quantify losses and damages, develop data-driven insights, and communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role requires the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards of quality, integrity, and client service.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Review financial records and other business documents to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and potential misconduct.
* Analyze financial data, trace discrepancies, and investigate suspected fraud or financial irregularities.
* Research, forecast, and develop strategies to help prevent financial fraud and minimize business risk.
* Investigate complex business matters and support clients in resolving financial, operational, and compliance-related issues.
* Prepare reports, presentations, schedules, and analyses explaining findings, including revenue losses, damages, and impacts arising from contract breaches.
* Provide litigation support, including preparing financial analyses and presenting findings for use as potential trial evidence.
* Conduct financial record audits and reviews to assess compliance with applicable laws, regulations, professional standards, and contractual requirements.
* Lead the development of quantitative data analysis, data mining, and database-driven reporting solutions in support of forensic investigations, litigation, and regulatory compliance inquiries.
* Conduct engagements in accordance with applicable professional, legal, regulatory, and firm requirements.
* Support successful engagement execution by working within project parameters, managing resources and processes, and anticipating and resolving issues.
* Deliver high-quality client work while meeting project budgets, timelines, and realization objectives.
* Explain complex accounting, analytical, and technical concepts clearly to non-technical client personnel.
* Provide value-added strategies and practical recommendations that help clients achieve their business objectives.
* Apply an understanding of each client’s business, industry trends, benchmarking data, and forensic accounting practices to develop effective solutions.
* Identify opportunities to add value for existing clients and support the development of new business opportunities.
* Contribute to the firm’s brand awareness, market visibility, and growth within relevant industries.
* Manage multiple investigations and projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Economics, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in forensic accounting, transaction advisory, internal audit, external audit, investigations, fraud risk management, disputes, litigation support, or financial consulting.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, audit procedures, and financial analysis.
* Experience reviewing financial records, analyzing large data sets, identifying discrepancies, and preparing well-supported conclusions.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly.
* Strong problem-solving, research, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize competing deadlines, and work effectively with limited supervision.
* Willingness to travel based on client and engagement requirements.
* High level of professional integrity, discretion, and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional qualification or progress toward qualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA, CMA, CFE, or a comparable credential.
* Experience supporting fraud investigations, economic damages calculations, contract disputes, regulatory inquiries, or litigation matters.
* Experience with data analytics, data mining, database-driven reporting, or forensic technology tools.
* Familiarity with financial crime risks, fraud schemes, internal controls, regulatory compliance, and investigative methodologies.
* Experience using tools such as Power BI, SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, IDEA, ACL, or other data analytics and visualization platforms.
* Experience working with clients across multiple industries and presenting findings to senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to identify client needs, develop practical recommendations, and contribute to business development initiatives.
* Experience mentoring junior team members or coordinating workstreams within a broader engagement team.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect forensic accounting analysis to client business objectives.

title: Senior Manager– Strategic Finance
description:
Sr. Manager– Strategic Finance

**Location:**
Noida

**About the Role**

We're hiring an Sr. Manager to be the senior voice in the room for Finance Business Partnering — the person functional leaders turn to when a budget number, a headcount ask, or a business case needs a real answer, not just a report. This is not an execution role. We already have operational coverage; what's missing is someone with the judgment to independently run a leadership conversation, push back on a weak assumption, and turn analysis into a recommendation the CFO or a functional VP will actually act on.

You'll manage one Manager, partner directly with R&D, GTM, Customer Success, and G&A leadership, and work closely with the Director – Strategic Finance on budget cycles, strategic deep-dives, and leadership-facing analysis. This is the clearest growth path in the team into a future Director-level seat.

**What You'll Own**

**Finance Business Partnering**

* Embedded partnership with R&D, GTM, Customer Success, and G&A — budget discussions, headcount planning, spend optimization, resource allocation
* Own business cases and project economics for new initiatives, and defend them in front of functional and finance leadership
* Independently run recurring budget and performance conversations with functional heads — not just prepare the materials for someone else to present

**Strategic & Analytical Judgment**

* Unit economics and profitability analysis to support initiative evaluation and ROI decisions
* Translate variance and performance data into a point of view, not just a readout
* Flag risks and challenge assumptions proactively, before they reach the Director or CFO

**Team Leadership**

* Manage the Manager – Business Finance: set priorities, review output quality, and coach them toward handling more senior conversations independently
* Act as the quality bar between operational output and what's fit to put in front of leadership

**Cross-Coverage**

* Stay close enough to MIS, performance reporting, and forecasting to step in during close or budget-season crunch — this role is expected to flex across both pillars, not stay siloed in business partnering

**What We're Looking For**

* 6–8 years in FP&A, Strategic Finance, or business partnering roles, ideally in SaaS or high-growth tech
* CA / CFA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent
* Demonstrated ability to run a budget, headcount, or spend conversation directly with a functional leader and hold your ground on the numbers
* Some people-management experience, or clear readiness to manage and develop a direct report
* Strong modeling and analytical skills; comfort working with AI/automation tools for first-pass analysis so your time goes to judgment, not production
* Calm, direct communication style — able to deliver an unwelcome number without softening the substance

**Why This Role**

This is the seat built for someone who's outgrown pure execution but hasn't yet had the platform to lead leadership conversations independently. You'll get real stakeholder ownership, a direct reporting line to the Director, and a defined path toward a future Director-level role as the team scales.

title: Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Description – Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager, Finance & Accounts

Department: Finance, Accounts, MIS

Location - Noida

Job Type - Full-Time

Job Summary:

To manage and oversee finance and accounting operations for the Media & Digital business,

ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely billing and collections, effective cost control,

statutory compliance, cash-flow management and strong financial governance.

The role will also act as a finance business partner to business teams by providing timely

MIS, commercial insights, project profitability analysis and financial support for business

decisions.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in accounting, taxation, financial reporting,

receivables/payables management, budgeting, MIS, audits (Internal & Statutory), and

internal controls, along with the ability to independently manage finance operations and

coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Operations

\* Manage day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate and timely recording of

financial transactions.

\* Prepare and review ledgers, reconciliations, provisions, accruals and accounting

adjustments.

\* Ensure proper maintenance of books of accounts in accordance with applicable

accounting standards and company policies.

\* Oversee month-end and year-end closing activities.

\* Review balance sheet schedules and ensure timely reconciliation and resolution of

outstanding items.

2. Accounts Receivable & Payable

\* Monitor customer receivables, outstanding payments and ageing.

\* Drive timely collection of outstanding invoices and coordinate with business/sales team

for payment recovery.

\* Review vendor invoices, payment requests and ensure timely processing of vendor

payments.

\* Monitor advances, debit/credit notes and other outstanding balances.

\* Maintain an effective receivables and payables tracker.

3. MIS & Financial Reporting

\* Prepare and review monthly financial MIS, management reports and business dashboards.

\* Provide analysis of revenue, expenses, profitability & cash flow.

\* Provide meaningful financial insights to management to support business decisions.

4. Commercial Finance & Contract Review

\* Review financial and commercial aspects of client agreements, POs, contracts and

business proposals.

\* Validate billing terms, payment milestones, credit periods and financial commitments.

\* Highlight commercial and financial risks before execution of contracts.

\* Support business teams in negotiations from a financial perspective.

\* Monitor contract-wise revenue, cost and profitability.

5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

\* Review GST/TDS reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies.

\* Maintain proper documentation for statutory compliance and audits.

6. Audit & Compliance

\* Coordinate with internal, statutory and tax auditors.

\* Provide required schedules, supporting documents and information for audits.

\* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.

\* Strengthen internal financial controls and ensure compliance with company policies.

7. Internal Controls & Process Improvement

\* Establish and monitor effective financial controls and approval mechanisms.

\* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy.

\* Automate and streamline finance processes wherever possible.

\* Ensure proper segregation of duties and adherence to financial policies.

8. Banking & Treasury

\* Monitor & Manage fund requirements and support cash-flow planning

\* Coordinate with banks for foreign inward collections and payments & other banking

requirements.

9. Business Partnering

\* Work closely with business, procurement, sales, legal and other departments on finance-

related matters.

\* Provide financial guidance on contracts, commercial arrangements, pricing and business

proposals.

\* Support management in evaluating financial implications of business decisions.

\* Act as a finance partner to business teams while ensuring financial discipline.

10. Team Management

\* Lead, guide and develop the finance and accounts team.

\* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.

\* Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly and annual finance activities.

\* Build a culture of accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.

Key Deliverables / KRAs

\* Timely and accurate monthly financial closing.

\* Accurate and timely MIS and management reporting.

\* Reduction in outstanding receivables and improved collection efficiency.

\* Timely vendor payments and effective payable management.

\* 100% timely statutory and tax compliance.

\* Timely completion of audits with minimum observations.

\* Improved financial controls and process efficiency.

\* Reduction in accounting errors and unreconciled balances.

\* Successful implementation of finance process improvements and automation.

Required Qualifications

\* CA Inter / MBA (Finance) / M.Com / B.Com or equivalent qualification.

\* 6–8 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably with experience in a

managerial role.

\* Strong knowledge of accounting, taxation, financial reporting and statutory compliance.

\* Experience in managing audits, MIS, budgeting and working capital.

\* Good understanding of ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel.

Preferred Skills

\* Financial accounting and reporting

\* GST, TDS and Income Tax

\* MIS and variance analysis

\* Receivables & collections management

\* Payables and vendor management

\* Cash-flow management

\* Audit and internal controls

\* ERP / accounting software

\* Advanced MS Excel

\* Team management

\* Process automation and improvement

Key Competencies

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

\* High level of accuracy and attention to detail

\* Ownership and accountability

\* Strong communication and negotiation skills

\* Ability to work under deadlines

\* Leadership and team-management capability

\* High integrity and confidentiality

\* Process-oriented and proactive approach

**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP S/4HANA RTR Lead Consultant with SAP S/4HANA RTR functional & technical experience executing and delivering a complex migration project from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA. The candidate will be responsible for the configuration of SAP S/4HANA Target System to receive selected data migrated from a current SAP ECC system to ensure a seamless transition, while providing expert guidance and support to clients throughout the configuration build, testing and cutover activities of their journey to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities: Functional and Technical Consulting:**
Leading Workshops AS IS / TO BE Process to map requirements from business process understanding, cost management and reporting, integration with other modules and systems, overall business strategy.
  
  
Provide expert guidance and support in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis. Work with SAP S/4HANA Core Team to configure and customize SAP S/4HANA functionalities to meet client requirements, ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards.
  
  
Develop technical solutions and enhancements to support data migration, integration, and reporting requirements.
  
  
Provide guidance and support with S/4 HANA transformation project including configuration, Data Migration, providing functional Expertise, trouble shooting, User training.
  
  
Designs and optimizes controlling processes to meet the business needs.
  
  
**Business Process Analysis And Optimization**
Work closely with finance and control departments to understand their processes and needs.
  
  
Analyze existing financial processes and suggest improvements.
  
  
Ensure the SAP system is aligned with business financial operations and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Testing, Training, And Support**
Develop and execute test plans, scenarios, and scripts to validate SAP S/4HANA configurations and functionalities.
  
  
Conduct system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and regression testing to ensure system reliability, accuracy, and performance.
  
  
Collaborate with business users to resolve issues, address concerns, and implement solutions to meet project objectives.
  
  
Train end-users on the functionality of SAP S/4HANA RTR Workstream
  
  
Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for SAP RTR Workstream issues.
  
  
**Integration And Data Migration**
Ensure seamless integration of the S/4 Finance Accounting with other SAP modules like Order to Cash, Sourcing & Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain.
  
  
Oversee data migration from SAP ECC/legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
  
  
Work with the Selective Data/Bluefield Migration Team on the migration of data from Customer’s SAP ECC System target SAP S/4HANA System to ensure minimal business disruption and maximum efficiency.
  
  
Collaborate with data migration and technical teams on activities regarding data extraction, transformation, and loading into SAP S/4HANA during build, test and cutover phases of the project.
  
  
**Reporting And Analytics**
Develop and maintain financial accounting reports and dashboards using SAP tools.
  
  
Assist in the utilization of SAP S/4HANA's embedded analytics capabilities to provide actionable insights into financial data.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement And Communication**
Act as the primary point of contact for key business and IT stakeholders including business users, project sponsors, and IT teams, providing regular updates, progress reports, and presentations on project status and milestones.
  
  
Proactively engage with stakeholders to gather and validate requirements, address concerns, and obtain feedback throughout the migration and transformation process to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, fostering trust and confidence in the migration process and deliverables.
  
  
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  
  
**Skill & Experience Required**
10+ years of experience in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis, implementation and support.
  
  
Strong analytical Skills to analyze complex business data, identify potential issues, business challenges, recommend and develop solutions implementing with SAP Best practices.
  
  
Should be well versed with end-to-end Product costing processes including Material Ledger functionality with integration points with other modules like Product Planning, Materials Management, Order to Cash etc.
  
  
Should have worked on reports and able to identify the requirement and integrate effectively with SAP BW/BI or other reporting tools.
  
  
Certification in SAP S/4HANA is required.
  
  
Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead customer engagements at an executive level.
  
  
Excellent interpersonal skills in areas such as teamwork, facilitation, and negotiation
  
  
Strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical audiences including the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport, persuades others, and establishes domain expertise.
  
  
Working knowledge of SAP Activate Roadmap for Central Finance
  
  
Primarily Remote with occasional onsite meetings
  
  
**Nice to Have**
Experience, knowledge in other SAP modules and migration tools, such as Data Migration Cockpit, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, Inventory Management and Warehouse Management is a plus.
  
  
Prior experience with SAP RISE implementations.
  
  
Understanding of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) applications and use cases.
  
  
Understanding and working knowledge of SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) and potential integration scenarios using MDG.

**What Makes Us, Us**

Understanding customer problems, market needs, and implementation challenges, and translating them into scalable standardized solutions.

* Fluency in English, written and spoken.
* Knowledge of Agile principles and experience working in cross-functional product teams.
* Personal qualities: customer-focused, self-motivated, collaborative, well-organized, eager to learn, outcome-oriented, commercially aware, and passionate about creating products that deliver real value

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. Travel industry experience isn’t needed. Attention to detail and the drive to get it right are.

and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
  
  
**Wellbeing Focus**
- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
  
  
**Paternity Leave:**
We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
  
  
**Travel perks**
: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
  
  
**A career, not a job**
: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
  
  
**Reward & Recognition**
: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  
  
**Love for travel**
: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  
  
**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
  
  
As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
  
  
We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
**Brightness of Future.**
We encourage you to
**DREAM BIG**
through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
  
  
**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

title: Deputy Manager, Financial Operations
description:
The Advanced Specialist, Financial Operations is a senior individual contributor within Global Rights & Royalties. The role owns complex royalty data analysis, supplier and royalty reconciliations, database integrity, advance and earnings payments, and the accurate application of agreement and product structures across multiple geographies.

  
  

Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will lead payout-based projects, make standard and non-standard operational recommendations, and provide trusted advice on royalty processing, product structures and payment setups. You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to resolve complex issues, strengthen data quality and ensure that royalty outcomes align with contractual requirements and business objectives.

  
  

You will also work closely with the Manager to monitor critical deliverables, maintain transparent progress reporting, lead quality and validation activities, prepare preliminary transaction reporting, and improve the capability of the wider team through mentoring and technical guidance.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  
  

**1. Royalty Data Integrity and Calculation Assurance**

  

  
* Analyse complex royalty data and validate the integrity of the royalty calculations database and connected operational records.
  
  
* Ensure royalty calculations, statement outputs, advances and earnings payments reflect approved agreement terms, product structures and payment setups.
  
  
* Conduct routine and risk-based quality checks, control reviews and data validation exercises across high-value or complex royalty activity.
  
  
* Identify data gaps, anomalous results and processing risks; assess root causes and coordinate corrective action before release or payment.
  
  
* Maintain clear, audit-ready evidence of analysis, validation, decisions, approvals and adjustments.
  

  

**2. Reconciliations, Supplier Accounts and Payments**

  

  
* Lead the reconciliation of royalty supplier accounts, statements, advances, earnings and related balances, identifying and resolving discrepancies promptly.
  
  
* Maintain supplier and payment-related records and ensure accurate, authorised and complete system entries.
  
  
* Oversee complex royalty statement and payment processing, ensuring compliance with contractual terms, operating procedures and relevant controls.
  
  
* Review unusual, high-value or non-standard payment scenarios and make recommendations within delegated authority.
  
  
* Escalate legal interpretation, tax, policy or commercial decisions to the accountable specialist or business owner with a clear statement of facts and impact.
  

  

**3. Global Payout Projects and Operational Delivery**

  

  
* Lead or provide senior specialist support for payout-based projects across multiple geographies, from analysis and planning through validation and controlled delivery.
  
  
* Define operational requirements, dependencies, risks, control points and acceptance criteria in partnership with the Manager and project stakeholders.
  
  
* Monitor milestones, exceptions and actions, communicating progress and decision requirements clearly and early.
  
  
* Coordinate cross-functional inputs to ensure project outcomes align with business objectives, contractual requirements and operational readiness.
  
  
* Conduct post-implementation review and translate lessons learned into stronger processes, controls and documentation.
  

  

**4. Advisory Support on Agreements and Product Structures**

  

  
* Provide expert operational advice on royalty payouts, product structures, agreement terms and payment setups to support accurate processing and informed business decisions.
  
  
* Assess the operational impact of proposed or existing structures and highlight dependencies, limitations, risks and downstream consequences.
  
  
* Partner with Portfolio, Editorial, Rights, Royalties, Finance, Legal and other owners to clarify requirements and support correct system treatment.
  
  
* Distinguish operational application from formal legal or commercial interpretation and route decisions to the appropriate accountable owner when required.
  
  
* Promote consistent application of approved standards across markets, products and royalty processes.
  

  

**5. Stakeholder, Author and**
**OneCRM**
**Escalation Management**

  

  
* Provide timely, clear and evidence-based responses to complex stakeholder, author and agent inquiries.
  
  
* Ensure prompt and high-quality action on OneCRM tickets, prioritising material, aged or recurring escalations and driving them to resolution.
  
  
* Analyse escalation trends to identify systemic issues, control weaknesses and opportunities to improve author experience.
  
  
* Build trusted relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups and influence resolution of complex operational matters.
  
  
* Communicate risks, trade-offs and recommendations in a way that enables timely decisions.
  

  

**6. Technology Partnership and Sustainable Issue Resolution**

  

  
* Partner with technical teams and business stakeholders to investigate data inquiries, system defects, interface issues and processing anomalies.
  
  
* Translate operational and contractual requirements into clear business scenarios, expected outcomes and validation criteria.
  
  
* Support root-cause analysis, solution design, testing and implementation validation to ensure issues are resolved sustainably.
  
  
* Challenge temporary workarounds where they introduce control or scalability risk and recommend practical long-term solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to automation, reporting-tool development, data governance and process standardisation initiatives.
  

  

**7. Reporting, Controls and Audit Readiness**

  

  
* Prepare preliminary reports, summaries and analysis of royalty transactions, reconciliations, exceptions and payout activity for team and management review.
  
  
* Work with the Manager to monitor key tasks, service levels, risks, backlogs and project progress, ensuring accurate and transparent reporting.
  
  
* Maintain adherence to policies, procedures, approvals, contractual requirements, data privacy obligations and regulatory standards.
  
  
* Prepare complete documentation and work papers for author audits, internal reviews, external audits and control testing.
  
  
* Identify and communicate emerging risks or unusual circumstances, supported by impact analysis and recommended actions.
  

  

**8. Technical Leadership and Team Capability**

  

  
* Provide day-to-day technical guidance, mentoring and constructive quality feedback to junior colleagues and peers.
  
  
* Help ensure the quality of tasks, analysis and advice provided by self and others without formal line-management accountability.
  
  
* Share specialised knowledge through coaching, process documentation, case reviews and learning sessions.
  
  
* Promote strong ownership, customer focus, control discipline and continuous improvement across the team.
  
  
* Support the Manager in prioritising complex work and building resilient operational capability.
  

  

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
* Substantial relevant experience in royalty operations, financial operations, publishing, rights administration or a comparable complex transaction environment. Experience in publishing, rights or royalties is strongly preferred.
  
  
* Demonstrated expertise in royalty or financial data analysis, reconciliations, payment processing, database validation and complex discrepancy resolution.
  
  
* Experience leading projects, workstreamsor material operational deliverables across multiple stakeholders or geographies.
  
  
* Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring to colleagues and improving the quality of team outputs.
  
  
* Strong experience managing internal and external stakeholders and communicating complex information, risks and recommendations.
  

  

**Preferred Experience**

  

  
* Knowledge of royalty calculations, author agreements, product structures, advances, earnings payments and intellectual property management tools.
  
  
* Experience with supplier account maintenance, OneCRM or comparable case-management workflows, author inquiries and escalations.
  
  
* Experience supporting audits, control testing, system implementation, data migration, automation or reporting-tool development.
  
  
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with royalty, ERP, workflow, database or business intelligence tools.
  
  
* **KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**
  
  
* GRR Management and Royalty Operations | Portfolio and Editorial | Rights and Intellectual Property Management | Finance and Controllership | Tax and Accounts Payable | Technology and Transformation | Legal and Compliance | Internal and External Audit | Authors, Agents and Other Approved Stakeholders

title: Lead – Finance Controller
description:
**Responsibilities**
Financial Control & Governance
  
  

* Lead financial control and governance framework across projects and business units.
* Establish and monitor financial policies, controls, procedures, and accounting standards.
* Ensure adherence to internal control mechanisms and corporate governance requirements.
* Drive financial discipline and safeguard organizational assets through effective control processes.
* Monitor financial risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

Financial Planning & Business Finance
  
  

* Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.
* Review project-wise profitability, cash flow forecasts, and business performance metrics.
* Support strategic planning, investment decisions, and business growth initiatives.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to leadership for informed decision-making.
* Evaluate business performance against approved targets and budgets.

Financial Reporting & MIS
  
  

* Oversee preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
* Ensure accuracy and timeliness of management reports, dashboards, and business performance reviews.
* Analyze financial statements, project profitability, revenue trends, and cost structures.
* Present financial performance updates and key business insights to senior management.
* Develop advanced MIS frameworks for real-time financial monitoring.

Project Finance & Commercial Oversight
  
  

* Monitor project financial health, fund utilization, and cost management.
* Review project CAPEX, project costs, revenue recognition, and profitability analysis.
* Partner with Project, Procurement, Sales, CRM, and Business Development teams to drive financial efficiency.
* Ensure financial viability assessments for new projects, investments, and land acquisitions.
* Support commercial negotiations from a financial risk and profitability perspective.

Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  
  

* Oversee cash flow planning and liquidity management across projects and business operations.
* Monitor fund inflows, outflows, receivables, payables, and working capital requirements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of financial resources and availability of adequate funds.
* Coordinate with treasury teams on funding requirements and cash management strategies.
* Drive initiatives for optimizing working capital and cash conversion cycles.

Compliance, Audit & Risk Management
  
  

* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, taxation regulations, statutory requirements, and corporate policies.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Lead audit closure activities and ensure timely resolution of audit observations.
* Monitor compliance risks and strengthen internal control frameworks.
* Support implementation of risk management and compliance initiatives.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Business Heads, Project Teams, Procurement, Sales, CRM, Legal, Commercial, and Treasury functions.
* Act as a strategic finance partner to business leadership.
* Present financial reviews, business cases, and performance reports to senior stakeholders.
* Support management committees, board reviews, and business planning discussions.

Team Leadership & Process Excellence
  
  

* Lead and mentor finance teams across projects and business functions.
* Drive process improvements, financial automation, and digital reporting initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Build team capabilities through coaching, training, and performance management.
* Establish best practices in financial reporting, controls, and business partnering.

**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.
* MBA (Finance), CMA, or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage.
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or related discipline.

Experience
  
  

* 12–18 years of experience in Finance Controllership, Business Finance, FP&A, Project Finance, Corporate Finance, or Financial Management.
* Strong experience within Real Estate, Infrastructure, Construction, EPC, Manufacturing, or Project-based organizations.
* Experience in handling large project portfolios, financial governance, statutory compliance, and leadership reporting.
* Proven track record in budgeting, profitability management, business partnering, and internal controls.

title: Finance Executive
company: India's Future Investors - Money Entertainment Reality Show
description:
**Company Description**
India’s Future Investors (IFI) is India’s Money Entertainment Reality Show, where real-world financial decisions are made under intense time and pressure. Through immersive challenges and practical money scenarios, IFI explores how people think, prioritize, and act when stakes are high. The show combines money intelligence, human behavior, competition, and entertainment to discover “India’s Money Rockstar.” IFI invites viewers not only to watch, but also to participate, compete, and follow the journey as contestants prove their financial acumen. The platform offers a unique opportunity for finance professionals and enthusiasts to be part of an innovative concept at the intersection of media, entertainment, and financial literacy.
  
**Role Description**
The Finance Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Noida. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day finance operations, including preparation and review of financial statements, monitoring cash flows, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities. The Finance Executive will handle financial reporting, ensure timely and accurate compliance with Goods and Services Tax (GST) and other regulatory requirements, and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors as needed. The role includes analyzing financial data to support decision-making for production, marketing, and operational teams, as well as maintaining organized financial records and documentation. The Finance Executive will also contribute to process improvements, internal controls, and financial best practices to support the growth and sustainability of the show.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Finance and Financial Statements, including preparation, review, and interpretation.
* Candidates should possess experience in Financial Reporting, with the ability to produce accurate, timely reports for management and regulatory purposes.
* Candidates should possess Goods and Services Tax (GST) expertise, including filing, reconciliation, and compliance with current regulations.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills, with the capacity to evaluate financial data, identify trends, and support strategic decisions.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel, along with attention to detail and strong numerical skills.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration abilities to work with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant academic background such as a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CMA, MBA in Finance) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in media, entertainment, or production finance is beneficial but not mandatory; willingness to learn and adapt is essential.

title: Senior D365 Finance & Operations Application Lead
description:
About the Role:
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Senior D365 Finance & Operations Application Lead to own the functional operation, development roadmap, and continuous improvement of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment.
  
  
You will be the primary IT partner for Finance, Procurement, Logistics, and Operations, combining business process expertise with technical capabilities, application governance, and delivery coordination.
  
  
Working closely with our Senior D365 Engineer in India, who leads technical architecture and development, you will drive the transition from external vendors to sustainable internal engineering and support capabilities.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end application ownership, without direct line management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Application Ownership & Business Partnership:
  
  
  

* Own D365 Finance & Operations and its business-critical integrations, including connected expense, reporting, and integration services.
* Translate Finance, Procurement, and Logistics requirements into functional solutions, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
* Provide expertise across GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory, Tax, and related workflows.
* Ensure application reliability, business continuity, and readiness for financial closing periods.
* Define service expectations, escalation paths, and SLAs/OLAs with business and IT stakeholders.

Functional Engineering & Delivery:
  
  
  

* Perform hands-on D365 configuration, troubleshooting, and selected enhancements.
* Read, debug, and review X++ code, contributing to development where appropriate.
* Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with the Senior D365 Engineer on solution design, technical feasibility, and delivery planning.
* Coordinate testing, UAT, releases, deployments, business acceptance, and documentation.

Internalization & Vendor Management:
  
  
  

* Lead the transition of agreed development and support activities from external partners to internal teams.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, source code, technical assets, documentation, and operational handovers.
* Establish clear responsibilities, support processes, and delivery capabilities across Switzerland and India.
* Manage vendor performance, service agreements, transition milestones, risks, and dependencies.
* Reduce external dependencies while maintaining service continuity and quality.

Operations, Governance & Budget:
  
  
  

* Own application service quality, incident coordination, problem resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee integrations, application security roles, access reviews, segregation of duties, and audit compliance.
* Ensure alignment with ITSM, security, change, and release management processes.
* Coordinate distributed engineering resources, delivery commitments, and stakeholder communication.
* Act as Cost Center Owner, managing application budgets, licensing, contracts, and external service costs.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and improved reliability.

What You Bring:
  
  
  

* 8+ years in ERP, enterprise applications, consulting, or application management, ideally including 5+ years with D365 Finance & Operations.
* Strong functional knowledge of Finance, Procurement, and operational ERP processes.
* Hands-on D365 configuration, troubleshooting, and practical X++ development experience, including code analysis and debugging.
* Experience managing application roadmaps, requirements, delivery, integrations, testing, and production support.
* Proven ability to manage external ERP partners, knowledge transfer, and transitions to internal engineering teams.
* Experience collaborating with distributed teams and coordinating technical delivery without direct line authority.
* Understanding of application security, financial controls, audit requirements, and ITSM practices.
* Strong business partnering, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills.

Additional advantages: Advanced X++ development, Azure, Power Platform, Logic Apps, REST APIs, Power BI, Linux, automation, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, ITIL, German language skills, and relevant Microsoft certifications.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within your first 12 months, you will have:
  
  
  

* Established trusted functional ownership and a transparent D365 roadmap.
* Built an effective delivery partnership with our India-based engineering team.
* Transitioned agreed vendor activities into sustainable internal capabilities.
* Improved application reliability, support processes, and financial closing readiness.
* Delivered hands-on improvements while strengthening governance, documentation, and audit readiness.
* Reduced vendor dependency and improved budget transparency.

Your Mindset
  
  
You combine business understanding, technical expertise, and strong ownership. You are equally comfortable working with Finance stakeholders and engineers, translating complex requirements into practical solutions.
  
  
You communicate clearly, challenge existing processes constructively, and focus on reliable, maintainable solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
*As our Global IT application portfolio evolves, additional business application responsibilities may be assigned.*

title: Global Finance and Admin Manager
description:
**Position: Global Finance Manager**

**Location: Noida**

**Role Type: Full Time**

Cancard Inc has been a multi-technology company based in Markham (Toronto) since 1989. Both Cancard and its sister company, Advaa Health, are at the forefront of transforming primary healthcare through technological innovation. Our mission is to empower primary care physicians with state-of-the-art digital tools and solutions that streamline their practices and significantly reduce administrative burdens and operational costs. Amidst increasing paperwork and complex administrative tasks faced by healthcare professionals, we serve as a key partner, enabling physicians to focus on patient care.

Our healthcare product portfolio leverages cutting-edge technologies in data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to offer seamless, intuitive, and cost-effective solutions. By integrating our systems, primary care practices can enhance patient engagement, optimize appointment scheduling, automate billing and coding processes, and access comprehensive patient health records in real-time. These advancements not only improve the quality of care provided but also contribute to a significant reduction in overhead costs.

The role will combine financial planning, strategic project management, and operational excellence to ensure business growth and efficiency. This position will have direct experience and exposure to customers in US, Canada, and other global markets.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Financial Planning & Strategic Projects**

* Prepare, manage, and track yearly/monthly sales and expense budgets to optimize working capital and profitability.
* Generate daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports with actionable insights.
* Lead and support strategic and product development projects in collaboration with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* Develop project reports, monitor deliverables, and ensure timely project completion within budget.
* Identify risk areas, bottlenecks, and recommend solutions.
* Oversee resource planning for smooth office operations.
* Support event planning, including trade shows, conferences, and internal team meetings.

**Administrative & Financial Operations**

* Manage
  **Accounts Receivable & Payable**
  to reduce DSOs, ensure timely vendor payments, and maintain optimized working capital.
* Supervise the filing, storage, and retrieval of financial and corporate records.
* Facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders, including policy announcements, newsletters, and customer/vendor updates.
* Ensure team, vendors, and customers are aligned with strategic goals.
* Address customer/vendor queries and resolve escalations effectively.
* Ensure legal and regulatory compliance with local, state, and federal laws.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field (CA, CPA, CFA preferred).
* 7–10 years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, or financial planning, preferably in global or multinational environments.
* Strong expertise in financial reporting, budgeting, and project management.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple projects, prioritize, and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, ERP systems, and financial tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Flexible working hours.

• A dynamic and supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.

• The chance to work on meaningful projects that have a real impact on healthcare.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples or project portfolios to HR@cancard.com. In your cover letter, explain why you're interested in this role and how your background and experience make you a good fit for our team.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Cancard, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Cancard is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Conduct balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding reconciling items in a timely manner.
* Manage accounting for reserves, commissions, client cost allocations, and foreign exchange-related transactions.

Technical Competencies

* Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Communication & Collaboration
  
  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders across regions and functions.
* Experience working in multicultural and global environments.
* Strong influencing and collaboration skills with a customer-centric approach.

Digital & AI Mindset
  
  

* Comfortable working with digital tools, automation solutions, and AI-enabled technologies.
* Interest in leveraging data and technology to improve business outcomes.
* Learning agility and openness to adopting new ways of working.
* Ability to translate business challenges into digital or automation opportunities.

**Experience**

title: Senior Manager Corporate Finance
description:
Senior Manager – Business Finance

Team: Corporate Finance

Location: Noida

Experience: 2–4 years

Education: B.Tech / B.E. or quantitative degree from a Tier-1 institute (preferred)

About the role

You will sit where finance meets data: you'll turn large operational datasets into P&L decisions on cost (cost per kg, fleet mix, vendor share), revenue (account and segment profitability) and reporting. You will build the analysis, then automate it so it runs without you.

What you'll do

• Cost and margin analytics: Break down unit economics (cost/kg, cost/shipment, load factor, vehicle utilisation) by facility, lane and vendor type, and separate the levers you can act on from mix effects and noise.

• Revenue and profitability: Support account-level gross margin actioning, segment P&L, and pricing and revenue-leakage reviews.

• SQL at scale: Write and optimise Trino/Presto queries on high-volume shipment, billing and fleet tables, and reconcile the outputs against finance books.

• Python automation: Turn recurring analyses into scripts (pandas, openpyxl) that produce stakeholder-ready Excel and Word outputs, including files too large for Excel.

• Dashboards and mailers: Build QuickSight dashboards and Google Sheets/Apps Script automations, such as scheduled flash mailers to regional and ops teams.

• Variance and scenarios: Build MoM/WoW variance bridges and split movements into volume, rate and mix. Model scenarios such as EV adoption and fleet right-sizing.

• Storytelling: Turn the numbers into crisp, deck-ready commentary for leadership: lead with the "so what" and back it with the number.

• Execution: Coordinate inputs across Ops, Product, BD and Finance, track initiatives to closure, and own data quality end to end.

Must-haves

• Strong academic pedigree: B.Tech/B.E. or a quantitative degree from a Tier-1 institute (IITs, NITs, BITS, IIITs, DCE/NSUT, ISI, SRCC/St. Stephen's Economics or equivalent). An MBA from IIM/ISB/XLRI/FMS is a plus.

• 2–4 years in analytics, strategy, consulting, FP&A or a data role. Experience at a top analytics firm or high-growth consumer/logistics tech company is preferred.

• Strong SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs, performance on large tables). This is non-negotiable.

• Working Python (pandas): you have automated something real, not just done coursework.

• Advanced Excel: financial modelling, pivots, lookups and clean model structure.

• Sharp business logic: you can explain why a metric moved, not just that it moved.

• You reconcile numbers obsessively and catch data errors before they reach a stakeholder.

Good to have

• QuickSight, Tableau or Power BI; Google Apps Script

• Exposure to logistics, supply chain or other unit-economics-driven businesses

• Finance basics: P&L structure, gross margin, revenue recognition (IndAS 115 a plus)

• Comfort using AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to speed up coding and analysis
